'''Thanar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], where he dispensed gear to [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and other agents of the Empire.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Thanar first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Korriban Commendations vendor aboard Vaiken Spacedock; he was later relabeled as the Level 8 Equipment Vendor.<ref name="TOR" />
